actualGitHeadBasis: the fixture reads the REAL commit of its own test-owned repository (see fixture-git-basis-real check)
controlInput: existing canonical Work Context + existing PriorResultContext
treatmentInput: the SAME context + the qualified Trajectory Section

r2vrQualificationRequirements.statement: the CONTROL baseline must be neither at the floor nor at the ceiling of the outcome scale
at least two outcome dimensions must vary across CONTROL repetitions
at least one treatment-relevant failure class must vary across CONTROL repetitions
the actual Trajectory content must address a varying outcome
the apparent result must not be entirely determined by an unrelated residual case

baselineOnlyDiscipline: the first stochastic stage runs CONTROL only; Treatment is not enabled by the presence of a Capsule
